web-guide-idea-65.offer: Create a moderated practice environment focused on listening, structure and contribution. The value is observation and feedback, not winning an argument.
web-guide-idea-65.steps.0: Introduce a balanced practice topic and ground rules.
web-guide-idea-65.steps.1: Run a timed discussion while observing participation.
web-guide-idea-65.steps.2: Give specific feedback and repeat a short round.
web-guide-idea-65.equipment: A phone, earphones and prepared topics.
web-guide-idea-65.returnReason: Rotate topics and assign new roles so returning participants practise different habits.
web-guide-idea-65.promotion: Explain the feedback criteria and share a short fictional example of a stronger contribution.
